title: Answer It or Not? Towards Prompt-Adapted Adversarial Images on Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.16622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the advancement in language modeling, research on adversarial images has recently shifted from image classifiers to vision-language models (VLMs). Despite the new, text-prompt-driven nature of VLMs, we find that existing VLM adversaries have largely overlooked the dynamics of text prompts. In a typical use case, adversarial images can protect visual privacy by rejecting VLMs from answering questions about the image. However, existing protections are prompt-agnostic, i.e., indiscriminately rejecting any question, including those for potential legitimate use of the image. To address this limitation, we propose Prompt-Adapted (ProAda) adversarial images, which are optimized to balance the rejection of harmful prompts and the correct response of legitimate prompts. translated_title: 回答还是不回答？面向视觉语言模型的提示自适应对抗图像
translated_abstract: 随着语言建模技术的发展，对抗图像的研究最近已从图像分类器转向视觉语言模型（VLMs）。尽管VLMs具有新颖的、由文本提示驱动的特性，我们发现现有的VLM对抗方法在很大程度上忽视了文本提示的动态性。在典型的使用场景中，对抗图像可以通过阻止VLM回答关于图像的问题来保护视觉隐私。然而，现有的保护方法是与提示无关的，即不加区分地拒绝任何问题，包括那些对图像有潜在合法用途的问题。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了提示自适应对抗图像，该方法经过优化，能够平衡对有害提示的拒绝与对合法提示的正确响应。特别地，为了实现更精确的对抗方向，文本提示也会通过一个简单的分类器进行迭代更新，该分类器用于判断有害性……
tldr: 提出了提示自适应对抗图像，能够有选择地拒绝有害提示以保护视觉隐私，同时允许对合法提示的正确响应，克服了现有方法不加区分拒绝所有问题的缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Prompt-Adapted (ProAda) adversarial images that selectively reject harmful prompts while allowing correct responses to legitimate prompts, addressing the prompt-agnostic limitation of existing VLM adversarial protections.
